title: New Cancer Vaccine Shows Success in Major Trial
subtitle: A combined treatment using mRNA technology helps prevent skin cancer from returning in patients.

summary.en: Pharmaceutical companies Moderna and Merck have announced positive results from a large Phase 3 clinical trial. The study tested a new, personalized vaccine for patients with high-risk melanoma. By using mRNA technology, the vaccine helps the immune system identify and attack cancer cells. Patients who received the vaccine alongside a standard drug stayed cancer-free for longer. Experts are optimistic but emphasize that the full results still require independent review.
summary.zh: 製藥公司莫德納與默克宣布了一項大型第三期臨床試驗的正面結果。該研究針對高風險黑色素瘤患者測試了一款新型個人化疫苗。透過運用信使核糖核酸技術，該疫苗能協助免疫系統辨識並攻擊癌細胞。接受疫苗與標準藥物合併治療的患者，維持無癌狀態的時間更長。專家對此持樂觀態度，但強調完整結果仍需經過獨立審查。

paragraphs.en: A new, personalized vaccine has shown success in stopping skin cancer from returning in patients, according to a recent announcement by drug companies Moderna and Merck. This development is being described as a significant moment in cancer treatment. The vaccine was tested on patients with high-risk melanoma—a serious type of skin cancer—after they had already undergone surgery to remove the disease.
paragraphs.zh: 根據藥廠莫德納 (Moderna) 與默克 (Merck) 近期的公告，一款新型個人化疫苗在防止皮膚癌患者復發方面展現了成效。這項進展被視為癌症治療領域的重要時刻。該疫苗針對的是已接受手術切除病灶、屬於高風險黑色素瘤（一種嚴重的皮膚癌）的患者進行測試。

paragraphs.en: According to BBC Health, this new treatment is given in combination with an existing immunotherapy drug called Keytruda. Immunotherapy is a type of treatment that helps the body’s own immune system fight cancer. The trial results suggest that using the vaccine and the drug together is more effective than using the drug alone. It significantly increased the time patients remained cancer-free and lowered the risk of the cancer spreading to other organs.
paragraphs.zh: 根據英國廣播公司健康頻道 (BBC Health) 的報導，這種新療法是與現有的免疫治療藥物「吉舒達 (Keytruda)」合併使用。免疫治療是一種協助人體自身免疫系統對抗癌症的治療方式。試驗結果顯示，同時使用疫苗與該藥物，比單獨使用藥物更為有效。這顯著延長了患者維持無癌狀態的時間，並降低了癌症擴散至其他器官的風險。

paragraphs.en: Ars Technica reports that the Phase 3 trial included 1,137 patients. In this type of study, participants were randomly assigned to receive either the combination treatment or the drug alone. The trial was double-blind, meaning that neither the doctors nor the patients knew which treatment each person was receiving. This method helps ensure that the results are fair and accurate.
paragraphs.zh: 科技媒體 Ars Technica 報導指出，第三期臨床試驗共納入 1,137 名患者。在此類研究中，參與者被隨機分配接受合併治療或單獨用藥。該試驗採用雙盲方式，意即醫師與患者雙方皆不清楚每個人接受的是哪種治療。這種方法有助於確保研究結果的公正與準確。

paragraphs.en: The vaccine, known as Intismeran, uses mRNA technology. This is the same technology used in some Covid-19 vaccines. To create this personalized medicine, scientists take a small part of a patient’s tumor and study its DNA. They then create a vaccine that teaches the patient's immune system to recognize and attack any remaining cancer cells that are specific to that person. Ars Technica noted that the vaccine can target up to 34 unique mutations in a patient's cancer cells.
paragraphs.zh: 這款名為 Intismeran 的疫苗採用了信使核糖核酸 (mRNA) 技術，這與部分新冠肺炎疫苗所使用的技術相同。為了製作這種個人化藥物，科學家會取下患者腫瘤的一小部分並研究其去氧核糖核酸 (DNA)。接著，他們會研發出一款疫苗，教導患者的免疫系統辨識並攻擊該名患者體內殘存的特定癌細胞。Ars Technica 指出，該疫苗最多能鎖定患者癌細胞中 34 種獨特的突變。

paragraphs.en: While the companies have reported that the results are statistically significant, they have not yet released all the details. These findings are expected to be shared at an upcoming international medical conference. Previously, data from a five-year Phase 2 trial showed a 49 percent reduction in the risk of the cancer returning or death, and a 59 percent reduction in the risk of the cancer spreading to other parts of the body.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管兩家公司表示研究結果具有統計學上的顯著意義，但尚未公布所有細節。這些發現預計將在即將舉行的國際醫學會議上分享。此前，一項為期五年的第二期試驗數據顯示，癌症復發或死亡風險降低了 49%，而癌症擴散至身體其他部位的風險則降低了 59%。

paragraphs.en: Despite the excitement, experts are urging people to remain cautious. Dr. Talisia Quallo from Cancer Research UK stated that while the research "shows promise," the current data still needs to be fully reviewed by independent experts. This process, known as peer review, is a standard part of scientific research where other experts check the findings to make sure they are correct. Furthermore, even if the results are confirmed, the treatment would still need to pass through strict approval processes by health regulators before it could be made available to the public.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管各界感到振奮，專家仍呼籲大眾保持審慎。英國癌症研究協會 (Cancer Research UK) 的塔莉西亞·夸洛 (Talisia Quallo) 博士表示，雖然這項研究「展現了前景」，但目前的數據仍需經過獨立專家的全面審查。這種稱為同儕審查的過程是科學研究的標準環節，由其他專家核實研究發現以確保其正確性。此外，即便結果獲得證實，該療法在正式對外開放使用前，仍須通過衛生監管機構嚴格的審核程序。

paragraphs.en: Dr. Lennard Lee, a consultant medical oncologist at the University of Oxford, believes the study has wider importance. He noted that the trial provides "proof of principle" that personalized cancer vaccines can actually work. If this success continues, the companies hope to use similar methods to treat other types of cancer, such as lung, bladder, and kidney cancers.
paragraphs.zh: 牛津大學 (University of Oxford) 的腫瘤內科顧問醫師藍納德·李 (Lennard Lee) 博士認為，這項研究具有更廣泛的意義。他指出，該試驗提供了個人化癌症疫苗確實可行的「原理驗證」。若此成功案例能持續，兩家公司希望運用類似方法治療其他類型的癌症，例如肺癌、膀胱癌與腎臟癌。

paragraphs.en: For now, the medical community is watching closely. The announcement has already had a financial impact, with shares in both Moderna and Merck rising since the news was shared. As research continues, the goal remains to provide more patients with personalized options that could help them live longer and healthier lives. For patients with high-risk melanoma, this new approach offers a hopeful step forward in a difficult battle against the disease.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，醫學界正密切關注此事。這項公告已產生財務影響，莫德納與默克的股價在消息公布後皆有所上漲。隨著研究持續進行，目標仍是為更多患者提供個人化選擇，協助他們活得更長久、更健康。對於高風險黑色素瘤患者而言，這種新方法在對抗疾病的艱難戰役中，邁出了充滿希望的一步。

previousArticles.title: New Cancer Vaccine Shows Promise in Major Medical Trial
previousArticles.summaryEn: Moderna and Merck have announced positive results from a large clinical trial for a new cancer vaccine. The vaccine is designed to treat melanoma, a serious form of skin cancer. It works by teaching the immune system to recognize specific mutations in a patient's cancer cells. Patients who received the vaccine alongside standard treatment saw better results than those who did not. The companies plan to share more detailed data at a future medical conference.

quiz.question: What is the specific role of the vaccine, Intismeran, in the treatment process for high-risk melanoma patients?

options.A: It replaces the need for surgery by eliminating tumors.
options.B: It trains the immune system to identify and attack specific cancer cells left behind after surgery.
options.C: It acts as a standalone treatment that replaces the need for immunotherapy drugs like Keytruda.
options.D: It prevents the initial development of skin cancer in healthy individuals.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第四段，該疫苗的作用是教導患者的免疫系統識別並攻擊患者體內殘留的、針對該個人特有的癌細胞。選項 A 錯誤，因為手術後才使用疫苗；選項 C 錯誤，因為文章第二段指出它是與 Keytruda 藥物結合使用，而非取代它；選項 D 錯誤，因為研究對象是已經動過手術的患者，而非預防健康人罹癌。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why might the medical community be cautious about the reported success of the vaccine?

options.A: The vaccine has already been proven to cause severe side effects in most patients.
options.B: The mRNA technology used has been declared unsafe by international health regulators.
options.C: The full results have not yet undergone the standard process of independent expert verification.
options.D: The financial rise in Moderna and Merck shares suggests the results were manipulated for profit.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第六段，儘管結果令人興奮，但專家提醒需保持謹慎，因為目前的數據尚未經過「同行評審」（peer review），即由獨立專家進行審查以確保正確性。選項 A 與 B 在文中均未提及；選項 D 雖然提到股價上漲，但文章並未暗示數據造假，這僅是市場對消息的反應，而非醫學界謹慎的原因。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the phrase 'proof of principle' most closely mean in the context of Dr. Lennard Lee's statement?

options.A: A demonstration that a theoretical idea can be put into practical, successful action.
options.B: A legal document that confirms the patent rights of the pharmaceutical companies.
options.C: A set of strict rules that all medical researchers must follow during a trial.
options.D: A summary of the ethical guidelines regarding personalized medicine.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在第七段中，Dr. Lennard Lee 提到該試驗提供了「proof of principle」，意指這項研究證明了個人化癌症疫苗的概念不僅僅是理論，而是可以實際運作並產生效果的。選項 B、C、D 皆與「證明理論可行性」的語境不符，屬於對詞彙的錯誤解讀。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of this article regarding the new cancer vaccine?

options.A: The vaccine is a guaranteed cure for all types of skin cancer.
options.B: The use of mRNA technology is the only way to treat modern cancer patients.
options.C: The vaccine represents a promising, personalized advancement in cancer treatment that requires further validation.
options.D: The financial success of Moderna and Merck is the most important outcome of the recent vaccine trials.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。本文的核心在於報導一項結合 mRNA 技術與免疫療法的個人化疫苗試驗，該試驗展現了治療皮膚癌的潛力，但同時也強調了需要經過嚴格的同行評審與監管審核。選項 A 過度誇大；選項 B 錯誤，文中未說這是「唯一」方法；選項 D 將經濟影響置於醫學進展之上，偏離了文章報導癌症治療的主旨。
